dedupe_keys.name: roclib bias corrected climate projections for romania

description: The Romanian climate research team publishes RoCliB, a bias-corrected EURO-CORDEX ensemble for Romania and its surrounding grid. Version 2.0 provides daily mean, minimum and maximum air temperature and precipitation at 0.1 degree spacing, covering 20.1–29.8 degrees east and 43.5–48.4 degrees north. Historical simulations span 1971–2005; RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 scenarios span 2006–2100. Ten listed driving-model and regional-model combinations were adjusted with MBCn against ROCADA observations. Zenodo supplies compressed NetCDF files compliant with CF-1.4, free under CC-BY-4.0 while explicitly retaining original CORDEX terms. The combinations are not ten independent driving models. Bias correction does not remove scenario or model uncertainty. These series can drive water-resource, agricultural and building-energy simulations. They complement data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds with a regional, observation-adjusted CMIP5-era ensemble. The data and correction performance were not independently tested.
